name: meridian-16
title: MERIDIAN-16 — 64Kx16 static RAM chip
description: Build MERIDIAN-16: a synchronous 64K x 16-bit static RAM with byte-enables, a write-enable, an address latch, and an output-enable. It must store and recall a known test pattern and the testbench must print MERIDIAN:PASS.
context: 64K depth means 16-bit address. Clocked write (we) with two byte-enable bits be[1:0]. oe gates the output (tristate via 1'bz). Async read when oe=1. Test: write pattern at several addresses, read back, assert equality, print MERIDIAN:PASS.

manifest.purpose: 64K x 16 synchronous RAM with byte enables and tri-state output
manifest.ports: input clk, input [15:0] addr, input [15:0] din, input we, input [1:0] be, input oe, output [15:0] dout
manifest.behavior: with we=1 write 16'h1234 to addr 0 (be=2'b11); zero addr1 by writing 16'h0000 (be=2'b11), then write 16'hABCD to addr1 with be=2'b10 (only high byte); check addr0 reads 16'h1234 and addr1 reads 16'hAB00; with oe=0 the output must be high-impedance. Print mem64k:PASS only if all correct.
